selection: Two deterministic SHA256-ranked eligible keys per district, then direct-alias examples to 15; no price/error-based selection.
limitations: This verifies address matching against the pinned OSM snapshot, not cadastral or on-site location.
15 selected addresses were inspected against raw tags and geometry; registry cardinality, identity and original hashes were checked exhaustively.
No model fitting or prediction was performed; this does not assess prediction accuracy.
